provenance.source: JPL Horizons at the shared 3 September 2026 epoch; nominal published pole with arbitrary fixed phase.
provenance.qualification: Computed Shoemaker–Levy 2 Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose. A smooth approximation of the published proportions. Two pole orientations fit the lightcurves; this uses Model 1. The grid marks missing surface imagery. Rotation phase is illustrative.
